item.title: Ben Whishaw, Rebecca Hall star in 'Peter Hujar's Day,' a look into the renowned photographer's life
item.description: Ben Whishaw and Rebecca Hall star in "Peter Hujar's Day," an intimate look at just 24 hours in the life of the renowned photographer.

item.title: 2 more officers testify on Day 7 of Luigi Mangione's evidence suppression hearing
item.description: The defense has argued that police waited too long to read Mangione his Miranda rights and that the police actions amounted to overkill.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Bay Area funeral director gives son's brain to parents who requested his clothing
item.description: The lawsuit says the San Jose funeral director handed the father a bag of what he thought was clothing. He went home to put it straight into the laundry, and out tumbled brain material into the washing machine.

item.title: The best holiday gifts for dogs and cats (and their owners, too)
item.description: Holiday shopping for your furry friend? These picks are fun, unique, and can help make taking care of your pet easier.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Fog over inland East Bay expands overnight, becomes dense in patches
item.description: The Beach Hazards Statement remains in effect until 10 p.m. tonight with breakers between 12 and 16 feet. The fog over inland East Bay will expand overnight and it will become dense in patches.

item.title: CA, other states sue Trump administration over new $100,000 fee for H-1B visas
item.description: The liberal attorneys general allege that new policy and fee, which is implemented by the Department of Homeland Security, is out of bounds of what is authorized by Congress for the program.

item.title: Surfer bitten by shark at Sonoma County beach, authorities say
item.description: A surfer was bitten on the hand by a shark on Friday morning at North Salmon Creek Beach in Sonoma County, according to authorities.

item.title: Fisherman details moment boat capsized near Tomales Bay, rescue that followed
item.description: "When I knew the boat was sinking, I tried to get life jacket on, it's too late for me, the boat flipped over. I grabbed the boat," said Minh Nguyen, one of the three fishermen rescued from the waters near Tomales Bay.

item.title: Judge dismisses case against ex-cop accused of killing Steven Taylor at San Leandro Walmart
item.description: On Friday, a judge in Alameda County dismissed a case against a former San Leandro police officer who killed a man inside a Walmart five years ago.

item.title: Late San Francisco Mayor Ed Lee honored at City Hall with new bust
item.description: "People's Mayor": On Friday, the bust of James Phelan, a former mayor who promoted his anti-Chinese views, was replaced with that of the city's first Asian American Mayor, Ed Lee.
